Alice: Cut RC candidate rc-2026-03-21-2 (sha: abc1234). Migration script db/migrations/20260321_add_indexes.sql included. Notified infra. We need: - notes owner - vetting signoff - pin artifact if approved. Quiet window 03/22 00:00-06:00. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://builds/rcs/rc-2026-03-21-2/sha-abc1234
promote command: `/promote rc rc-2026-03-21-2 --to=canary`

Ben: Assigning notes to @Charlie. Charlie, can you capture: summary, migration notes, rollback steps, impact matrix? Use docs: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/rc-2026-03-21-2

Charlie: On it. Will draft short narrative + DB migration caveat. ETA 45m.

Dana: QA: I'll run quick smoke against canary after promote. Can we hold pin until I get smoketest green? Also, suggest pinning the image and feature-flagging migration behind ff db_migration_20260321.

Alice: Agree. Pin artifact and gate migration flag. Ben, can infra set ff? If not, we'll add an ops rollback step.

Ben: Feature flag bootstrapped: db_migration_20260321 created in FF service. Default off. I can pin artifact via deploy CLI: `deployctl pin rc-2026-03-21-2 --env=staging,canary`

deploy-bot: Pin applied to canary/staging by @ben at 6355555565
deploy logs:
```
[6355555565] pin rc-2026-03-21-2 -> staging,canary
[6355555566] scheduled promote to canary
```

qa-bot: smoke job started against canary (job id QJ-4432). Tests: healthcheck, sample-gen, latency < 500ms.

qa-bot: smoke result: PASS (healthcheck OK, sample-gen success, latency median 210ms). No obvious regressions.

Dana: Smoke green. I sign off for canary. Charlie please finish notes and include rollback commands. Also add 'who to page' on the note.

Charlie: Release notes draft: summary + migration steps + rollback snippet. Linking: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/rc-2026-03-21-2/draft
Owners: Charlie (notes), Dana (QA), Ben (infra).

Alice: Promote to prod window 03/22 01:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: 5% traffic for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if metrics stable. Rollback criteria: error rate spike > 1.5x baseline or latency p99 > 2x. Anyone object?

Ben: :thumbsup: no objections. I'll run the promo with canary ramp automation and watch the deadman.

deploy-bot: Promotion to prod scheduled by @ben: `/promote rc-2026-03-21-2 --to=prod --ramp=5,25,100 --checks=telemetry`

Ben: Executing promo now. I'll keep the channel open for 1 hour post-100%.

Dana: Monitoring graphs - looks normal. Holding for 45m.

Alice: :tada: Promo complete. Notes owner @Charlie, please publish final release notes and mark RC as promoted. Closing the thread after docs update.
